name: Orange-Scented Tzimmes with Carrots, Parsnips, Sweet Potato, Dried Apricots & Golden Raisins

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-low heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and large dice parsnips. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Peel, trim, and large dice sweet potatoes. Add to the bowl.
Small dice apricots and add to the bowl along with the raisins.
Zest one orange into the bowl, then juice both oranges into the bowl and set aside.
When the onions are done, add veggies and fruit to the pot along with water, honey, cinnamon, and salt; stir to combine the tzimmes. Cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup honey
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the tzimmes is simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, still covered, until the veggies and fruit are soft, about 45 minutes.
When the veggies and fruit are soft, uncover and continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Transfer tzimmes to a serving dish and enjoy warm or at room temperature!
